description: This Java class defines a PreferenceFragment for Android settings, specifically for general settings related to a text-to-speech engine. It sets a shared preferences name and loads preferences from a resource XML.

classes.name: GeneralSettingsFragment
classes.description: An Android PreferenceFragment for displaying general settings related to TTS engine, allowing configuration such as whisper mode.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the PreferenceFragment, sets the shared preferences name, and loads preference UI from a resource XML.
